validation.artifact_atime: Original assertion retained. Passing this run does not resolve prior observed external-access race; isolation remains blocked.

tradeoffs: Short 1000-call name-churn means regress +0.71% and +2.82%. Longer 20000-call name churn improves mean and p99.
Backend p99 worsens in both initial campaigns but improves in further 10 paired rounds. Tail variation cause not established.
Five-metric mean and span mean reverse direction; NumPy/rule p99 also mixed.
No additional warmed/cold string clone, API, dependency, buffer, lock, snapshot, wrapper or cross-language call introduced.
